subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and if so which callback/token handoff is acceptable for automation without weakening OAuth secret handling?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but choosing whether env callback URLs, device-code automation, external token injection, or another provider-owned handoff is acceptable changes auth-provider security policy and product surface.

options.title: Design provider-owned OAuth handoff
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a narrow contract with PKCE/state validation, redacted diagnostics, docs, and security-focused tests.

options.title: Accept env callback URL import
options.body: Implement the requested callback URL env shape directly with strict validation and docs, accepting the added exposure risk as product policy.

options.title: Defer to existing flows
options.body: Keep browser, manual paste, device-code, and API-key setup as the supported paths until upstream Codex exposes a stable external-auth contract.

recommendation.title: Design provider-owned OAuth handoff
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers choose a narrow contract with PKCE/state validation, redacted diagnostics, docs, and security-focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history spans non-interactive provider setup, OpenAI provider unification, and Codex runtime onboarding decisions.
